query_plan.query: When and where did the highest attendance at a FIFA world cup stadium occur and how many people attended?

steps.merge_task: Deduplicate matches, then return only the match with the highest attendance.
steps.query: Find all matches with their attendance, date and venue.

dependencies.dependency: The FIFA world cup match with the highest attendance with attendance, date and venue.

steps.merge_task: Return the given match with attendance, date and venue name and location as soon as it is found.
steps.query: Return the given match with attendance, date and venue name and location

extra.sql_query: SELECT venues.name AS venue_name, matches.attendance, matches.date, matches.name FROM matches INNER JOIN venues ON venues.venue = matches.venue WHERE matches.attendance = (SELECT MAX(attendance) FROM matches)

s1.sql_query: SELECT matches.match, matches.attendance, matches.venue FROM matches

s2.sql_query: SELECT venues.venue, venues.name, venues.country FROM venues WHERE venues.venue = 155174
